statement: A caller-supplied admin query timeout is treated as one absolute budget across control-snapshot pressure retries, so each retry receives only the remaining time and the server responds before caller expiry without weakening fail-closed observations, while the production five-node MovieLens milestone completes schema admission, durable ratings creation, 100000-row preload, ratings-only split convergence, and the successful three-way report.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Do not widen the 180000ms schema budget, weaken the 60000ms quiescence window, serialize scenario joins, reduce production logging, add a parallel freshness path, suppress topology or stale evidence, or rerun live without a changed deterministic owner invariant.

Retry budgeting must preserve fail-closed snapshot observations and the existing retry limit while bounding the complete server request within the caller-supplied timeout; it must not fabricate freshness or admission.
